WHY STAGE 2A WAS NOT SIMPLY RETUNED
For multivariate ridge with a common design matrix X, the ridge solution is linear in the target Y. If M_hat fits full next observation Y, then fitting a fixed task projection W Y directly gives exactly W M_hat (same regularization/intercept conventions). Recursively, an untruncated Capability basis is an exact factorization of the full ridge task prediction. Therefore passive same-data linear regression is not a valid place to demand a task-relative sample advantage. Stage 2B instead tests selective acquisition.

SCIENTIFIC SCOPE
This is a resettable/generative intervention benchmark with a known candidate causal skeleton and unknown true ancestry. Capability knows the terminal task-family targets but not their upstream causal ancestors. It chooses interventions only on candidate parents of the current task-relevant frontier. Full-ID uses the same intervention primitive but estimates the whole system. A positive result supports decision-directed acquisition under explicit sparsity/locality assumptions. It does not prove superiority over task-family-aware reward-agnostic RL or causal RL, which may exploit the same structure.

FROZEN KILL CRITERIA
K0: Capability must reach >=90% epsilon-adequate deployment decisions in every tested local-D condition.
K1: In local sparse skeletons, Capability interaction slope vs D should be <0.30 while Full-ID and Direct-Source exceed 0.70.
K2: Capability must beat uniform Random-SameBudget at the largest local D, and in the global/no-locality control it should lose the flat-D advantage (slope >0.60).
K3: Weak-edge interaction scaling should be broadly consistent with inverse-square identifiability.
K4: Task-family cost should grow with task ancestry; no claim of free universal transfer.
K5: Oracle-Ancestor is privileged. Random-SameBudget is diagnostic, not a strong RL baseline.
K6: Even Evidence 3 only licenses a later same-assumption comparison against strong reward-agnostic/causal RL.

THEOREM-MATCHING SAMPLE RADII
For a one-step intervention mean with Gaussian noise sigma, familywise confidence radius is r(n)=sigma/amp*sqrt(2 logterm/n). Under the beta-min assumption (edge is 0 or |a|>=beta_min), r<=beta_min/4 makes threshold beta_min/2 classify every tested coefficient correctly on the simultaneous-confidence event. This yields the predicted O(1/beta_min^2) classification burden.

INTERPRETATION BOUNDARIES
1. Candidate skeleton/locality is supplied to every causal learner. Unknown arbitrary relevance among D unrelated variables has an Omega(D)-type search cost.
2. The intervention oracle can reset at intermediate layers. This is stronger than ordinary online episodic RL.
3. The declared terminal task family is known before exploration, while individual scalar weights are post-hoc.
4. A task-family-aware reward-agnostic RL algorithm may realize the same structural benefit. If so, credit the principle, not a new algorithm.
5. This stage tests acquisition complexity, not learned visual/latent representation discovery.

LITERATURE ANCHORS FOR INTERPRETATION

- Ahuja et al. 2023, Interventional Causal Representation Learning, PMLR 202.
- Khorasani et al. 2025, Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Targeted Causal Interventions, PMLR 267.
